title: Grace Brunch
content: Please join us September 27th for a Sunday brunch that will begin at 9:45 a.m. Sausage, biscuits and orange juice will be provided.  Please bring a breakfast casserole, fruit, muffins or your favorite breakfast food.  Show off your cooking talent! However, If you don’t cook, store bought items work too. We look forward to seeing you there!
